messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechco.com>, Security Team <security@fintechco.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 packet and next steps

Hi Alex / FintechCo security team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the candid feedback on the integration needs. As promised, I've attached our SOC 2 packet for your review. Key highlights are below: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) and coverage summary
- Data retention & deletion controls overview
- Access controls and SSO/KMS notes
- List of endpoints and logging/audit capabilities

Attachments: [attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [attachment: SOC2_Summary.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

Next steps I propose:
1) Your security team reviews the packet; let us know if there are any blockers or outstanding evidence requests.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min security sync with Mateo (solutions engineer) to walk through any technical questions.
3) If everything looks good, we can move to legal for redlines and a mutual action plan.

Are there any questions we should anticipate from your side? If you have timing goals for this quarter, please share so we can prioritize.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

Apologies for the delay — the security team has been heads-down with a vendor freeze and the SOC2 packet is still under review. Appreciate you following up. A few quick notes / asks from our reviewers:

- Can you confirm your data retention defaults and whether we can set retention per-customer?
- We saw mention of KMS integration; can you share the KMS vendors you currently support and whether BYOK is available?
- If possible, a short call with Mateo to walk through the logging/audit trail (especially around export/delete operations) would be helpful.

We're aiming to close our vendor review by the end of next week; can you do a 30-min slot on Tue/Wed next week (anytime PST) for a technical sync?

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Security, FintechCo
